title: Trial: Samundar ke neeche Dwarka
note: Hand-written trial, never uploaded. Facts follow content/myth-topics.yaml (dwarka-underwater): NIO marine archaeology 1980s-2000s, dating disputed; scripture kept apart from finds.

scenes.say: Samundar ke neeche Dwarka, aisa dikhta hai.
scenes.picture: Photorealistic view under the sea off the Gujarat coast: ancient carved stone walls and a gateway on the sea floor, shafts of sunlight from the surface, drifting particles, teal and gold colours, no people, no text

scenes.say: Mahabharat kehta hai, Krishna ki nagri samundar mein doob gayi.
scenes.picture: Photorealistic dramatic coastal scene at dusk: a vast ancient city of stone towers and temple domes sinking beneath rising waves, storm clouds, golden light, cinematic, no people, no text

scenes.say: Toh kya yeh sirf ek kahani hai?
scenes.picture: Photorealistic aerial view of the Dwarka coastline in Gujarat at dawn, the Arabian Sea meeting the shore, a temple spire in the distance, mist, cinematic, no text

scenes.say: Unnees sau assi ke dashak se, samundar vigyan ke vaigyanik wahan gote lagane lage.
scenes.picture: Photorealistic underwater photograph of scientific divers with lights and measuring tape exploring a sea floor near the Indian coast, blue-green water, bubbles, no text

scenes.say: Unhe samundar ki tali par tarashe hue patthar ke dhaanche mile.
scenes.picture: Photorealistic close-up underwater of huge rectangular cut stone blocks lying in a line on the sea floor, algae and small fish, soft light, no text

scenes.say: Par yeh kitne purane hain, is par vidwaan ek raay nahi hain.
scenes.picture: Photorealistic underwater scene of weathered stone ruins fading into dark blue water, mysterious, a single shaft of light, no text

scenes.say: Kahani aur khoj alag hain, aur dono ko alag rakhna zaroori hai.
scenes.picture: Photorealistic split-feeling composition: on one side an ancient carved temple wall in warm light, on the other cool underwater stone blocks, calm, no text

scenes.say: Aur jo vaigyanik ko neeche mila, uski tasveer kuch aisi hai…
scenes.picture: Photorealistic underwater ancient carved stone doorway glowing faintly in dark blue water, light from the surface above, no text
